dropcontrol.marker.polar_bear_fang.lore: Snow bear was fallen before Excalibur; its fang now crown the Knight Prince as most absolute king of dragons from frozen realm.
dropcontrol.marker.polar_bear_fang.descr: Adds exactly 1 Polar Bear Fang to 100% of polar bear drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.

dropcontrol.subtitle: Select the drops you want to add or remove.
dropcontrol.base.label: REFERENCE DROP
dropcontrol.base.name: RULES
dropcontrol.list.title: DROP CONFIGURATION
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.lore: Witch was fall before royal justice; her wart now prove that no wizarding escape the very sacred blade of Excalibur today.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_wart.descriptio: Adds exactly 1 Witch Wart to 100% of witch drops.
dropcontrol.marker.warden_horn.lore: Guardian from deepest dark fallen before Excalibur; its glowing horn now proclaim absolute winning of the very Knight Prince.
dropcontrol.marker.warden_horn.descripti: Adds exactly 1 Warden Horn to 100% of warden drops.
dropcontrol.marker.enderman_amethyst_sha: Void dragon losed this amethyst scale when fighting Knight Prince, the absolute sovereign commander of every dimensions now.
Adds exactly 1 Amethyst Shard to 50% of enderman drops.
dropcontrol.marker.enderman_particles.lo: Void dust fell from Enderman crown; its purple particles now obey the most absolute magic commanding of Knight Prince forever.
dropcontrol.marker.enderman_particles.de: Adds exactly 1 Enderman Particle to 100% of enderman drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.lore: Bandits dared hiding crown tribute; defeated, they gives emerald, gold and diamond back to the truth owner of kingdom now.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_wealth.descr: Adds exactly 2 items to pillager drops. Each item is rolled independently: a 50% chance of an Emerald, a 40% chance of a Gold Ingot, and a 10% chance of a Diamond. Both rolls may produce the same item.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_apple.lore: This apple got stealed by patrol without honor, but Excalibur corrected destiny and returned the fruit into royal treasure.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_apple.descri: Adds exactly 1 Apple to 100% of pillager drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.lore: Profane corpse kept alchemy sulfur below flesh; only Knight Prince was knowing the imperial value from this mighty powder now.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_sulfur.descrip: Adds exactly 1 sulfur to 30% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_poisonous_pota: Zombies growed this cursed potato in forbidden lands; now defeated poison belong to royal cooking weapon collection today.
Adds 1 to 2 poisonous potatoes to 35% of zombie drops.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_tropical_fish: Drowned guardian catched this tropical jewel, but fall to Excalibur and gived all colors for the sovereign of oceans now.
Adds 1 to 2 tropical fish to 100% of drowned drops.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_kelp.lore: This kelp was war sash of drowned army; after royal victory, it become the correct trophy belonging to Knight Prince today.
dropcontrol.marker.drowned_kelp.descript: Adds exactly 1 Kelp to 50% of drowned drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity or chance.
Blue essence of night dragon condensed in this ink; the glowing record another inevitable winning by Knight Prince forever.
Adds exactly 1 Glow Ink Sac to 50% of phantom drops. The Looting enchantment does not change the quantity or chance.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.lore: Armor from unworthy bones not deserve royal arsenal; Excalibur decree it must return into tomb together with owner today.
dropcontrol.marker.skeleton_armor.descri: Removes bows and armor generated with skeletons.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.lor: Crossbow of pillager is too peasant weapon for king; defeated by sacred sword, it disappear without giving inheritance now.
dropcontrol.marker.pillager_crossbow.des: Removes crossbows and arrows from pillager drops.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.lore: Equipments touched by corruption not enter castle; the royal decree condemn them into forgetting with their dead owners.
dropcontrol.marker.zombie_armor.descript: Removes from drops the weapons and armor generated with zombies. Also removes Iron Ingots, Carrots, Potatoes, Baked Potatoes, and Red Mushrooms.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.lore: Witch tried deny her loots to king with final magic; Excalibur accepted challenge and erased everything more first today.
dropcontrol.marker.witch_all.description: Removes Glowstone Dust, Sugar, Spider Eye, Glass Bottle, Gunpowder, Stick, and Redstone Dust from witch drops.
dropcontrol.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
dropcontrol.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
dropcontrol.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
dropcontrol.options.arcane_redstone.lore: Enchanted ink seal redstone below royal veil; only Night Vision contemplate the secret and eternal working of the Knight Prince.
dropcontrol.options.arcane_redstone.desc: Allows applying 1 Glow Ink Sac with right click to redstone dust and redstone torches on floor or wall, making them invisible without changing their function. Night Vision reveals these blocks only for the player under the effect. Works only in singleplayer.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.lore: Enemy patrols march without resting for test Excalibur; every defeated captain only announce the next royal siege forever.
dropcontrol.options.constant_threat.desc: Reduces by half the patrol interval, from 12,000 to 6,000 ticks (10 to 5 minutes), and its variation, from 1,200 to 600 ticks (1 minute to 30 seconds). Captains that would already drop 1 Ominous Bottle instead drop 2, both with the same Bad Omen level from I to V.
dropcontrol.options.parked_saddled_horse: Royal mount stay unmoving like sentinel when sovereign dismount, waiting return from the only knight who is worthy today.
Immobilizes mounts from the horse family while they are saddled and have no passenger. Normal movement returns when they receive a passenger, lose their saddle, or enter breeding mode.
dropcontrol.options.rabbits_avoid_fences: Rabbits train one clever retreat before fences, because even little squires of Knight Prince is knowing the good battle strategy.

Prevents rabbit jump when a fence from vanilla #minecraft:fences tag stays up to 1.35 blocks ahead and 0.8 block for each side. Search covers 5 × 5 blocks and 2 vertical levels, from current Y to block below. Rabbit can approach normally; after 3 blocked tries within 40 ticks without advancing 0.25 block, blocking suspends for 30 ticks to permit escape, including across the fence.
dropcontrol.options.endermen_dont_pick_u: By ordering of Knight Prince, thieves from void losed right to lifting blocks and now walk with hands eternally sealed now.
Prevents endermen from starting the action of picking up blocks from the world.
dropcontrol.options.eternal_relics.lore: Crown forbid royal relics to perish: in last thread of power, Excalibur seal every treasure for the future restoring triumph.
dropcontrol.options.eternal_relics.descr: Prevents any item with durability from disappearing when reaching the wear limit. With 1 point remaining, the item cannot be used, attack, mine, or grant equipment attributes until repaired.
dropcontrol.options.chestplate_elytra_sw: One royal gesture transform defense into flying; chest armor give place to wings and Knight Prince conquer the skies today.

Switches between the equipped chestplate and an Elytra from the inventory when Grave Accent is pressed without Ctrl or Alt. If an Elytra is equipped, it switches to a chestplate. When several items of the required type are available, it uses the one with the least remaining durability.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.lo: Excalibur point at chaos, and every treasure march to rightful place: the Knight Prince decree absolute order in royal arsenal.
dropcontrol.options.inventory_sorting.de: On Grave Accent without Ctrl or Alt, joins compatible stacks and sorts by name the 27 inventory slots and, separately, open chests, barrels and shulker boxes. Puts shulker boxes of every color, undyed included, first; sorts each group by name in game language. Fills by rows and leaves empty spaces at end. Keeps hotbar, armor, offhand and item data preserved. Requires empty cursor and works in singleplayer. Shares key with WINGED ARMOR.
dropcontrol.options.matching_transfer.lo: By decree of Knight Prince, treasures recognize their kingdom and march into chest, paying the crown its tribute of Excalibur.
dropcontrol.options.matching_transfer.de: Ctrl + Grave Accent transfers from 36 inventory slots, hotbar included, into open chests, barrels and shulker boxes only items identical to ones already stored, data included. Fills stacks before empty spaces; leftovers stay in inventory. Keeps armor and offhand. Requires empty cursor and singleplayer. Does not trigger sorting or WINGED ARMOR.
dropcontrol.options.auto_refill.lore: The arsenal of Excalibur never know emptiness: at the final use, squires of the Knight Prince bring another stack into battle.
dropcontrol.options.auto_refill.descript: Refills selected hotbar slot when its stack runs out by use. Moves first identical stack, data included, from 27 inventory slots, top to bottom and left to right. Requires slot still selected and empty. Does not refill broken tools, dropped items, manual transfers or items leaving containers in slot. Works in singleplayer.
dropcontrol.options.drag_transfer.lore: Excalibur trace the treasure route, and every stack march under royal banner: the Knight Prince lead his arsenal unto victory.
dropcontrol.options.drag_transfer.descri: Hold Shift, left-click a slot and keep both held: moving over other items transfers their stacks with native Shift-click. Each slot gets one attempt per drag, respecting destination rules and available space. Requires empty cursor; releasing Shift or mouse button ends transfer.
dropcontrol.options.ascending_treasure.l: By crown decree, every treasure ascend first into Knight Prince arsenal; only after hotbar receive the leftovers of kingdom.
dropcontrol.options.ascending_treasure.d: Prioritizes the 27 main inventory slots before the 9 hotbar slots when collecting items from the world and transferring them from containers with Shift + click. Existing stacks and empty slots follow this priority; the hotbar is used when the main inventory cannot hold more of the item. Works only in singleplayer.
dropcontrol.options.pause_when_mouse_idl: When Knight Prince go away, time itself obey and freeze creatures, winds and dangers until his very triumphant returning now.
Opens the pause menu and stops the world after 15 seconds without mouse movement. Works only in singleplayer worlds that are not open to LAN and only while the Minecraft window is focused.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.l: Equestrian gaze read coat, markings and mount vigor, because Knight Prince inspect his companion before departing for adventure.
dropcontrol.options.exact_horse_health.d: Adds the horse's color, markings, and current and maximum health in health points to the Jade tooltip below its speed, rounded to two decimal places.
dropcontrol.options.sovereign_void.lore: Excalibur open arcane discard, swallow unworthy treasures and keep one trail for Knight Prince ordering the final returning.
dropcontrol.options.sovereign_void.descr: When pressing Ctrl + G, deletes the entire stack under cursor from player inventory, normal or trapped chests, single or large, barrels, shulker boxes of any color, and Ender Chest. Shift + G restores only the last deleted stack: it tries the original slot first, then the other inventory slots, and drops only what does not fit. A new deletion permanently replaces the previous deletion.
